column1: # Coverage ledger for tests/AnchorLayoutTests.cpp (GoogleTest migration; see tests/scripts/CoverageLedger.cmake).
# rows: 0 automatic, 15 hand. Port commits change statuses and never delete a row; rows with status new are not counted.

column5: ported;note:the inline check of main() is its own case, EXPECT_OK on XeLL::parse(raw_xell()); raw_xell moves byte for byte into tests/nand/AnchorFixture.cpp

ported;note:each && chain is one EXPECT per fact (the 0xD0B placeholder, the stated version and the unchanged rest through EXPECT_BYTES_EQ on subspans, the three hold-address searches, the two payload words); new ASSERT guards cover the sizes the old test indexed unchecked (rebooter and payload non-empty, the rebooter long enough for 0xD0B + 0x20, the stated rebooter as long as the core, the built payloads past 0x53)

ported;note:the 3x2 loop of anchors() is TEST_P AnchorLayout.KhvXellAndFusesAreAnchored, instantiated per shape (Small/, Big/ and Emmc/AnchorLayout, one bundle each) over rows Glitch2 and Glitch2m in the old order; fixture() is anchor_image() in tests/nand/AnchorFixture.cpp, same bytes; since N1 it returns Result<FlashImage> and every caller (these 6 rows, AnchorLayoutRoundTrip, Type/SpillChain, Mode/JtagWindow) takes it through ASSERT_OK_AND_ASSIGN, so a patchset that fails to parse fails the case at the fixture with context "anchor patchset" where the old fixture() skipped it silently; the continue after a failed write is ASSERT_OK; the KHV && chain is one EXPECT per fact; the XeLL and fuse spans are EXPECT_BYTES_EQ (the fuse span now also checks its 0x60 length, where all_of passed an empty read); the read-back is ASSERTs on write, read and parse, then EXPECTs on XeLL and fuses

ported;note:spill(type) is TEST_P SpillChain.OversizedCgSpillsThroughTheCfBlockListAndReassembles over Type/ rows Retail, Glitch2 and Jtag, one ctest entry per row (PER_ROW, about 2 s each); every early return is an ASSERT, one per fact; the 4 must() calls are ASSERT_OK; new ASSERT guards cover the CF and CG optionals and the CF data length before indexing; CG ciphertexts compare through ASSERT_BYTES_EQ; the random nonces mean only structure is compared

ported;note:jtag_window(mode) is TEST_P JtagWindow.PayloadsLandAtTheAnchoredWindowAndReadBackAsJtag over Mode/ rows Small and Big, bundled as nand.Mode/JtagWindow; the two precondition early returns are ASSERTs, one per fact; filled() and the window reads are EXPECT_BYTES_EQ against the expected fill or bytes; the read-back is an ASSERT on write and read, then EXPECTs on parse, build type, XeLL and fuses

ported;note:a plain companion of the AnchorLayout table, so its own suite (gtest forbids TEST and TEST_P in one suite); the two early returns are ASSERTs on write, read and parse, then one EXPECT per fact (cf_offset, fs_addr, the 16 bytes, the KHV address); be32 is test::be32

ported;note:fails_with (code, exact message, empty context) is EXPECT_ERROR_MSG, whose describe() equals the message only without context; all exact texts kept; the ok-and-value chains are EXPECT_OK plus EXPECT_EQ on value_or, the recorded spill ranges one EXPECT_EQ on their (name, offset, length) tuples, so no fact hides the next
